_comment_api: From https://my.telegram.org -> API development tools. The window fills these in for you.
_comment_speed: safest | normal | fast. Change it in the window under 'Speed & limits'. The delay values below are set from the preset.
_comment_break: Long human rest after every N messages.
_comment_typing: Typing indicator before each send: seconds per character, clamped.
_comment_hours: Only send inside these local hours.
_comment_known: People already in your contacts or with an open chat. Telegram's spam limits are not aimed at these, so there is no artificial cap. The clock is the limit.
_comment_new: People you have NEVER messaged. This is the number that gets accounts banned (PeerFlood = too many non-mutual users). Keep it low.
